hints.outputs: Use builds[].targets plus a build-level output template; include {ext} for platform executable extensions.
hints.consumers: Consumer wiring was removed; publish sections select artifacts with catalog filters and optional ids.
hints.downloadUrl: Download URLs are derived from publish.github.repository or supplied as a section-level catalog URL.
hints.$.project.package: Use project.packageName for package identity, or publish.npm.packageName for npm publishing.
hints.$.strict: Strict mode was removed; reviewable operations now encode validation behavior directly.
hints.$.npmPackage.id: The npm package artifact id is fixed as npm-package.
hints.$.publish.npm.trustedPublishing.packageE: Use verifyPackageExists for the optional read-only npm package existence check.
hints.$.pypiWheel.id: pypiWheel is one wheel family: state packageName/moduleName/consoleScript/requiresPython once at the top level, move wheel entries to pypiWheel.wheels, and move summary/homepage/license to project.
hints.$.pypiWheel.path: pypiWheel is one wheel family: state packageName/moduleName/consoleScript/requiresPython once at the top level, move wheel entries to pypiWheel.wheels, and move summary/homepage/license to project.
hints.$.pypiWheel.wheelTag: pypiWheel is one wheel family: state packageName/moduleName/consoleScript/requiresPython once at the top level, move wheel entries to pypiWheel.wheels, and move summary/homepage/license to project.
hints.$.pypiWheel.binaries: pypiWheel is one wheel family: state packageName/moduleName/consoleScript/requiresPython once at the top level, move wheel entries to pypiWheel.wheels, and move summary/homepage/license to project.
hints.$.pypiWheel.summary: Use project.summary (project.description also serves as the wheel summary); the per-wheel field was removed.
hints.$.pypiWheel.homepage: Use project.homepage; the per-wheel field was removed.
hints.$.pypiWheel.license: Use project.license; the per-wheel field was removed.
hints.$.publish.homebrew.artifactId: Use ids with one or more artifact IDs.
hints.$.publish.homebrew.artifactIds: Use ids with one or more artifact IDs.
hints.$.publish.homebrew.tokenEnv: Homebrew tap publishing uses ambient git credentials; tokenEnv was removed.
hints.$.publish.homebrew.homepage: Use project.homepage; the Homebrew field was removed.
hints.$.publish.homebrew.description: Use project.description; the Homebrew field was removed.
hints.$.publish.scoop.artifactId: Use ids with exactly one artifact ID.
hints.$.publish.scoop.tokenEnv: Scoop bucket publishing uses ambient git credentials; tokenEnv was removed.
hints.$.publish.scoop.homepage: Use project.homepage; the Scoop field was removed.
hints.$.publish.scoop.description: Use project.description; the Scoop field was removed.
hints.$.publish.scoop.license: Use project.license; the Scoop field was removed.
hints.$.publish.pypi.artifactIds: Use ids with one or more artifact IDs.
hints.$.publish.pypi.usernameEnv: Twine reads TWINE_USERNAME/TWINE_PASSWORD directly; the field was removed and the names are fixed.
hints.$.publish.pypi.passwordEnv: Twine reads TWINE_USERNAME/TWINE_PASSWORD directly; the field was removed and the names are fixed.
